# nd_fabric_groups (Resource)

Manages a Nexus Dashboard fabric group using the vxlan, vxlanAci, classic, ipfmFabricGroup, or ai management model. VXLAN and VXLAN-ACI groups expose advanced settings; the other models contain only a management type. Member fabric associations use separate API actions. All members must be removed before deleting the group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nd_fabric_groups" "test_resource_fabric_groups_1" {
  fabric_name                                     = "example_fabric_group"
  fabric_type                                     = "vxlan"
  anycast_gateway_mac                             = "2020.0000.00aa"
  category                                        = "fabricGroup"
  vrf_template                                    = "Default_VRF_Universal"
  network_template                                = "Default_Network_Universal"
  vrf_extension_template                          = "Default_VRF_Extension_Universal"
  network_extension_template                      = "Default_Network_Extension_Universal"
  l2_vni_range                                    = "30000-49000"
  l3_vni_range                                    = "50000-59000"
  scheduled_backup                                = false
  scheduled_backup_time                           = "02:00"
  underlay_ipv6                                   = false
  private_vlan                                    = false
  default_private_vlan_secondary_network_template = "Pvlan_Secondary_Network"
  security_group_tag                              = "off"
  security_group_tag_prefix                       = "SG_"
  security_group_tag_id_range                     = "10000-14000"
  security_group_tag_preprovision                 = false
  security_group_tag_mac_segmentation             = false
  downstream_vni                                  = false
  downstream_l2_vni_range                         = "60000-69000"
  downstream_l3_vni_range                         = "80000-89000"
  multisite_overlay_inter_connect_type            = "manual"
  route_server_collection = [
    {
      route_server_ip  = "192.0.2.10"
      route_server_asn = "65001"
    }
  ]
  route_server_redistribute_direct_route_map            = false
  route_server_routing_tag                              = 54321
  enable_multisite_overlay_inter_fabric_bgp_description = true
  auto_multisite_underlay_inter_connect                 = false
  bgp_send_community                                    = false
  bgp_log_neighbor_change                               = false
  bgp_bfd                                               = false
  multisite_delay_restore                               = 300
  multisite_inter_connect_bgp_authentication            = false
  multisite_inter_connect_bgp_auth_key_type             = "3des"
  multisite_inter_connect_bgp_key                       = "exampleEncryptedBgpKey"
  multisite_loopback_id                                 = 100
  border_gateway_routing_tag                            = 54321
  tenant_routed_multicast_ipv4_ipv6                     = false
  auto_configure_cloud_sec                              = false
  cloud_sec_key                                         = "070C285F4D06"
  cloud_sec_algorithm                                   = "AES_128_CMAC"
  cloud_sec_enforcement                                 = "strict"
  cloud_sec_report_timer                                = 5
  multisite_loopback_ip_range                           = "10.10.0.0/24"
  multisite_underlay_subnet_range                       = "10.10.1.0/24"
  multisite_underlay_subnet_target_mask                 = 30
  multisite_loopback_ipv6_range                         = "fd00::a10:0/120"
  multisite_underlay_ipv6_subnet_range                  = "fd00::a11:0/120"
  multisite_underlay_ipv6_subnet_target_mask            = 126
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `fabric_name` (String) Name used to identify the fabric group in API requests and Terraform import. The endpoint accepts names from 1 through 64 characters.
- `fabric_type` (String) Selects the fabric group management model. Allowed values are `vxlan`, `classic`, `ipfmFabricGroup`, `ai`, `vxlanAci`.

### Optional

- `anycast_gateway_mac` (String) MAC address shared by the VTEP anycast gateways. For vxlanAci, this must match the APIC default bridge domain MAC address. When omitted, the API defaults to `2020.0000.00aa` for vxlan and `0022.bdf8.19ff` for vxlanAci.
- `auto_configure_cloud_sec` (Boolean) Automatically configures CloudSec on border gateways. The API defaults to `false` when the attribute is omitted.
- `auto_multisite_underlay_inter_connect` (Boolean) Automatically configures Multi-Site underlay links between fabrics. When omitted, the API defaults to `false` for vxlan and `true` for vxlanAci.
- `bgp_bfd` (Boolean) Enables BFD for BGP on automatically created Multi-Site underlay links. The API defaults to `false` when the attribute is omitted.
- `bgp_log_neighbor_change` (Boolean) Enables BGP neighbor change logging on automatically created Multi-Site underlay links. The API defaults to `false` when the attribute is omitted.
- `bgp_send_community` (Boolean) Enables BGP community advertisement on automatically created Multi-Site underlay links. The API defaults to `false` when the attribute is omitted.
- `border_gateway_routing_tag` (Number) Routing tag associated with loopback and DCI interface addresses on border gateways. Within a vxlanAci group, this setting applies to NX-OS fabrics. Must be between 0 and 4294967295. The API defaults to `54321` when the attribute is omitted.
- `category` (String) Identifies the API object as a fabric group. The only allowed value is `fabricGroup`. Defaults to `fabricGroup` when not specified in the configuration.
- `cloud_sec_algorithm` (String) Algorithm used for CloudSec encryption. Allowed values are `AES_128_CMAC`, `AES_256_CMAC`. The API defaults to `AES_128_CMAC` when the attribute is omitted.
- `cloud_sec_enforcement` (String) Controls CloudSec enforcement. Strict enforcement requires traffic between sites to be encrypted. Allowed values are `strict`, `loose`. The API defaults to `strict` when the attribute is omitted.
- `cloud_sec_key` (String, Sensitive) CloudSec secret key encoded as a Cisco Type 7 encrypted hexadecimal string. Length must be between 1 and 130 characters.
- `cloud_sec_report_timer` (Number) Interval in minutes between CloudSec operational status reports. Must be between 5 and 60. The API defaults to `5` when the attribute is omitted.
- `default_private_vlan_secondary_network_template` (String) Template used to create secondary networks for private VLANs. The API defaults to `Pvlan_Secondary_Network` when the attribute is omitted.
- `downstream_l2_vni_range` (String) Layer 2 VNI allocation range used when downstream_vni is enabled. Use start-end syntax with endpoints from 1 through 16777214. The API defaults to `60000-69000` when the attribute is omitted.
- `downstream_l3_vni_range` (String) Layer 3 VNI allocation range used when downstream_vni is enabled. Use start-end syntax with endpoints from 1 through 16777214. The API defaults to `80000-89000` when the attribute is omitted.
- `downstream_vni` (Boolean) Enables separate VNI allocation for each member fabric. The API defaults to `false` when the attribute is omitted.
- `enable_multisite_overlay_inter_fabric_bgp_description` (Boolean) Adds BGP neighbor descriptions to automatically created Multi-Site overlay links. The API defaults to `true` when the attribute is omitted.
- `l2_vni_range` (String) Range used to allocate Layer 2 VNIs for overlay networks. Use start-end syntax with endpoints from 1 through 16777214. The API defaults to `30000-49000` when the attribute is omitted.
- `l3_vni_range` (String) Range used to allocate Layer 3 VNIs for overlay VRFs. Use start-end syntax with endpoints from 1 through 16777214. The API defaults to `50000-59000` when the attribute is omitted.
- `multisite_delay_restore` (Number) Time in seconds allowed for Multi-Site underlay and overlay control planes to converge. Must be between 30 and 1000. The API defaults to `300` when the attribute is omitted.
- `multisite_inter_connect_bgp_auth_key_type` (String) Encryption format of the Multi-Site BGP authentication key. Allowed values are `3des`, `type6`, `type7`. The API defaults to `3des` when the attribute is omitted.
- `multisite_inter_connect_bgp_authentication` (Boolean) Enables BGP authentication for Multi-Site interconnects. The API defaults to `false` when the attribute is omitted.
- `multisite_inter_connect_bgp_key` (String, Sensitive) Encrypted authentication key for Multi-Site BGP, encoded using multisite_inter_connect_bgp_auth_key_type. Whitespace is not permitted. Length must be between 1 and 256 characters.
- `multisite_loopback_id` (Number) Loopback interface number used for Multi-Site connectivity. Within a vxlanAci group, this setting applies to NX-OS fabrics. Must be between 0 and 1023. The API defaults to `100` when the attribute is omitted.
- `multisite_loopback_ip_range` (String) IPv4 prefix used to allocate Multi-Site loopback addresses, typically for Loopback100. Use IPv4 CIDR notation. The API defaults to `10.10.0.0/24` when the attribute is omitted.
- `multisite_loopback_ipv6_range` (String) IPv6 prefix used to allocate Multi-Site loopback addresses, typically for Loopback100. Use IPv6 CIDR notation. The API defaults to `fd00::a10:0/120` when the attribute is omitted.
- `multisite_overlay_inter_connect_type` (String) Selects how Multi-Site overlay interconnects are configured. Allowed values are `manual`, `routeServer`, `directPeering`. When omitted, the API defaults to `manual` for vxlan and `directPeering` for vxlanAci.
- `multisite_underlay_ipv6_subnet_range` (String) IPv6 prefix used to allocate point-to-point DCI link addresses. Use IPv6 CIDR notation. The API defaults to `fd00::a11:0/120` when the attribute is omitted.
- `multisite_underlay_ipv6_subnet_target_mask` (Number) IPv6 prefix length assigned to subnets allocated for DCI links. Must be between 120 and 127. The API defaults to `126` when the attribute is omitted.
- `multisite_underlay_subnet_range` (String) IPv4 prefix used to allocate point-to-point DCI link addresses. Use IPv4 CIDR notation. The API defaults to `10.10.1.0/24` when the attribute is omitted.
- `multisite_underlay_subnet_target_mask` (Number) IPv4 prefix length assigned to subnets allocated for DCI links. Must be between 8 and 31. The API defaults to `30` when the attribute is omitted.
- `network_extension_template` (String) Template used to extend overlay networks to border switches. The API defaults to `Default_Network_Extension_Universal` when the attribute is omitted.
- `network_template` (String) Template used to create overlay networks on leaf switches. The API defaults to `Default_Network_Universal` when the attribute is omitted.
- `private_vlan` (Boolean) Enables private VLANs on switches other than spines and super spines. The API defaults to `false` when the attribute is omitted.
- `route_server_collection` (Attributes List) Route servers used for Multi-Site overlay connectivity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--route_server_collection))
- `route_server_redistribute_direct_route_map` (Boolean) Enables the redistribute-direct route map for automatically created overlay links on route servers. Applies only to the centralizedToRouteServers deployment method described by the API. The API defaults to `false` when the attribute is omitted.
- `route_server_routing_tag` (Number) Routing tag for redistribution of directly connected routes associated with the route server IP used for eBGP EVPN peering. Must be between 0 and 4294967295. The API defaults to `54321` when the attribute is omitted.
- `scheduled_backup` (Boolean) Enables a daily backup at scheduled_backup_time.
- `scheduled_backup_time` (String) Daily backup time in UTC, expressed as HH:MM from 00:00 through 23:59. Used when scheduled_backup is enabled.
- `security_group_tag` (String) Controls security group enforcement. Strict enforcement allows only member fabrics with security groups enabled. The off value applies only to vxlan. Allowed values are `off`, `loose`, `strict`. The vxlanAci model permits only `loose` and `strict`. When omitted, the API defaults to `off` for vxlan and `strict` for vxlanAci.
- `security_group_tag_id_range` (String) Identifier allocation range for security group tags. Use start-end syntax with endpoints from 16 through 65535. The API defaults to `10000-14000` when the attribute is omitted.
- `security_group_tag_mac_segmentation` (Boolean) Enables MAC address segmentation for security groups. The API defaults to `false` when the attribute is omitted.
- `security_group_tag_prefix` (String) Prefix assigned to newly created security groups. Use letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens. Length must be between 1 and 10 characters. The API defaults to `SG_` when the attribute is omitted.
- `security_group_tag_preprovision` (Boolean) Pre-provisions security group configuration in VRFs where enforcement is disabled. When omitted, the API defaults to `false` for vxlan and `true` for vxlanAci.
- `tenant_routed_multicast_ipv4_ipv6` (Boolean) Tracks multicast VPN VRI identifiers at the Multi-Site fabric group to keep them unique across member fabrics. The API defaults to `false` when the attribute is omitted.
- `underlay_ipv6` (Boolean) Enables an IPv6 underlay. A false value selects an IPv4 underlay. The API defaults to `false` when the attribute is omitted.
- `vrf_extension_template` (String) Template used to extend overlay VRFs to border switches. The API defaults to `Default_VRF_Extension_Universal` when the attribute is omitted.
- `vrf_template` (String) Template used to create overlay VRFs on leaf switches. The API defaults to `Default_VRF_Universal` when the attribute is omitted.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The fabric group name returned by the API and used as the Terraform resource identifier.
- `security_group_status` (String) Security group operational status returned by the API. Returned values are `enabled`, `enabledStrict`, `enabledLoose`, `enablePending`, `enablePendingStrict`, `enablePendingLoose`, `disablePending`, `disabled`.

<a id="nestedatt--route_server_collection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `route_server_collection`

Optional:

- `route_server_asn` (String) BGP autonomous system number of the route server. Use an integer from 1 through 4294967295 or dotted notation with a first component from 1 through 65535 and a second component from 0 through 65535.
- `route_server_ip` (String) IPv4 or IPv6 address of the route server.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Format of ID used for import:
# Fabric group name.
terraform import nd_fabric_groups.test_resource_fabric_groups fabric_name
```
